description.zh:
190 年曹操在陈留起兵，此后群雄割据、官渡与赤壁两战奠定南北格局，魏、蜀、吴三国鼎立。263 年魏灭蜀，280 年西晋灭吴，三国时代结束。

> 本数据为 M77 示例初稿：路线为示意简化，事件日期、地点与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
In 190 Cao Cao raised troops at Chenliu. Warlords then divided the empire, and the battles of Guandu and Red Cliffs shaped a north-south balance. Wei, Shu, and Wu formed the Three Kingdoms. Wei conquered Shu in 263, and Western Jin conquered Wu in 280, ending the period.

> M77 illustrative draft: routes are simplified; dates, places, and wording await historical review.
